01 / Profile

Background & direction

Software meets
physical systems.

My work starts with a physical problem: a vessel needs to move, an obstacle will not stay still, or a product has to work for a real customer. I translate that uncertainty into systems that can be explained, simulated, tested, and used.

For my undergraduate thesis, I developed autonomous navigation for unmanned surface vehicles using DDPG as a parameter tuner for Lazy Theta* and Safe Artificial Potential Field path planning.

03 / Selected work

Research, product, application

P–01 / Undergraduate thesis / Jan — Jul 2026

Implementation of Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient as a Parameter Tuner
for Lazy Theta* and Safe Artificial Potential Field in Path Planning for the LSS-01 USV

Applied DDPG as an adaptive parameter tuner for both path-planning algorithms: heuristic and clearance weights in Lazy Theta*, plus attractive gain, repulsive gain, and safe distance in SAPF. Lazy Theta*-DDPG achieved a simulated path length of 50.3 m in 37.8 s, and the complete system was evaluated in simulation and on the LSS-01 platform.

  • Python
  • NumPy
  • OpenCV
  • Reinforcement Learning
  • USV Control
